objective: Establish repeatable routes from observed demand or owned supply to a measurable external economic effect without fabricating revenue.

routes.name: Owned MTG Inventory -> External Buyer

signal.evidence: Existing physical Magic inventory with known candidate cards and prices.

routes.buyer: NZ Magic: The Gathering buyer seeking a specific card
routes.proposition: One accurately described physical card with exact condition, edition and price.
routes.fulfillment: NZ shipping or pickup using the authorized channel workflow
routes.attribution: Listing ID -> buyer/payment -> inventory item -> fulfillment proof
routes.truth: External buyer + settled payment + correct attribution + fulfillment + independent proof
routes.replication: Only after one independently verified sale, replicate the same listing mechanism to additional proven inventory.

routes.name: Known Pain -> CMD Diagnostic Purchase

signal.evidence_required: Named buyer problem matching the published diagnostic proposition.

routes.buyer: Person or operator with the exact problem covered by CMD-DIAG
routes.proposition: CMD-DIAG-29 at NZ$29 with bounded deliverable and truth floor.
routes.attribution: Payment event -> offer SKU -> buyer/order -> fulfillment
routes.truth: Stripe livemode settled event plus fulfillment and independent proof
routes.replication: Repeat only after a verified external purchase.

routes.name: Observed Workflow Failure -> Monitoring Subscription

signal.evidence: Buyer-requested monitoring of three production workflows.

routes.buyer: The named n8n workflow operator from the observed opportunity
routes.proposition: Daily monitoring of three production n8n workflows for one month with same-day notification of missed runs or zero-record movement.
routes.fulfillment: Monitor the specified three workflows and provide the promised notifications.
routes.attribution: Opportunity ID -> authorized response -> buyer -> payment -> fulfillment
routes.truth: Do not claim revenue until payment settles and fulfillment is evidenced.
routes.replication: One paid fulfilled subscription must precede cloning the offer.

routes.name: Public Content Signal -> Digital Arbitrage Candidate
routes.buyer: To be discovered from promoted Gold signals
routes.proposition: Generated by Elohim only after a qualified signal exists.
routes.fulfillment: Bounded digital deliverable or verified arbitrage result
routes.replication: Replicate only demonstrated proposition and unit economics.

loop_model: SIGNAL -> GORMLET -> GOLD -> ELOHIM -> GAUNTLET -> CUBE -> COMMERCE_CELL -> ACQUISITION -> TRANSACTION -> FULFILLMENT -> TRUTH -> LEARNING -> NEXT_SIGNAL
first_external_effect_rule: A prepared packet is not an economic effect. Publication, buyer action and settled payment are external events.
